test_title: PYST 8: SSC JE EE - Reasoning (Held on: 24 March 2021 (Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the option in which the words share the same relationship as that shared by the given pair of words.

Tonsillitis : throat
solution:
Tonsillitis disease affect the throat

Similarly,

Polio disease affects the leg.

Hence, the correct answer “Polio: leg”.
